classification: assumption: finite field truncation and polar-dimer crystal model
description: Finite crystal of 32 charged pairs coupled to 63 electric and 32 magnetic TM field amplitudes; no NaCl parameter fit is asserted
intracell_potential: the original 3D nonlinear Coulomb-plus-short-range potential, restricted to the invariant axial slice
pair_centres: fixed lattice sites; centre-of-mass translation modes excluded
direct_short_range_intercell_force: absent; intercell coupling is through the retained Maxwell fields
field_geometry: 16 cells per half-space, spacing 1/8, outer faces at z=+/-2, interface z=0
parallel_boundary: one real TM Fourier sector, with continuous parallel wave number sqrt(6)
material_field_overlap: 1 on full material sites, 1/sqrt(2) on the interface site, 0 in vacuum
interface_note: A complete physical ion pair with reduced field overlap; no fractional ions or changed charges
bias_force: constant force U'(a) holds each pair at a; this force is explicitly represented in the potential
material_mass_normalized_hessian: b=U''(a)/3 in [1.999999,2.000001], proved rather than assumed
units: dimensionless finite-mode coordinates, as specified in Base/Model.lean
model_limit: A declared rigid-ion polar-dimer lattice with a finite EM mode basis; no all-pairs NaCl lattice potential or experimental correspondence is claimed
